image_description: A black and white photograph showing a large, silver airship (dirigible) resting on the ground at night. The airship has a long, cigar-shaped envelope with 'U.S. NAVY' text visible on the side. It features a gondola suspended beneath the forward section and distinct tail fins. To the right, a tall structure emits bright searchlight beams into the dark sky. Small vehicles or equipment are visible near the base of the airship.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific class label 'airship' and distinguish it from similar objects like blimps or airplanes using high-performance vision transformers.
To verify the 3D spatial relationship between the airship, the ground, and the searchlight tower, ensuring no geometric melting or floating artifacts.
To check for boundary sharpness and ensure the envelope is a single continuous entity without edge bleeding into the dark background.
To analyze the legibility and structural correctness of the 'U.S. NAVY' text, which is a common failure point for AI generation.

focus_areas: Structural integrity of the tail fins
Connection point between gondola and envelope
Legibility and geometry of 'U.S. NAVY' text
Edge definition against the dark sky
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text 'U.S. NAVY'. AI often generates gibberish text. Verify if the letters are distinct and correctly spelled. Also, check the shadow cast by the airship; does it align logically with the searchlight source on the right? Ensure the gondola doesn't appear to 'melt' into the hull.
